public interface ChangeHolder<Self extends ChangeHolder<Self, ChildType>, ChildType extends ChangeHolder.Child<Self, ChildType>>
A interface for allowing the production of new levels. Part of the level system, this and its child work in tandem . This interface is for the "true" instance of the object (The one with all the current changes) with the ChangeHolder.Child being the type that holds the changes ready to be applied.
